title: Anchoring Window by Tide State
dataSources: Battery telemetry (`marine:battery`), AIS traffic (`marine:ais`), shore power (`marina:power`), tide forecasts (`tide:table`), export syncs (`marine:export`).
app: Boating and marine telemetry — Victron BMV battery exports, AIS transponder logs, shore-power meter readings, and NOAA tide tables — streamed to Splunk HEC via NMEA exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tide:table tide_state=* anchor_window_min=*
| stats avg(anchor_window_min) as avg_anchor_window_min, count as events by tide_state
| sort - avg_anchor_window_min
description: Shows average anchor window minutes by tide state for anchoring opportunities.
value: Average anchor window minutes by tide state helps compare anchoring opportunities across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `anchor_window_min` on `tide:table` events and normalize `tide_state` so Splunk can summarize performance by tide state.
visualization: Bar chart of average anchor window minutes by tide state.
grandmaExplanation: It blends the average anchor window minutes for each tide state so you can see what works best for anchoring opportunities.
